title: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP does not sufficiently validate certain network input processed… (CVE-2026-76964)
description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP contains a vulnerability where certain network input is not sufficiently validated by an internal component. An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted network traffic to trigger memory corruption, potentially allowing arbitrary code execution and full system compromise. This vulnerability impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability with a critical severity rating.
